info.page.0:
Welcome to
§1§nDimensional Pockets

This entire book is to help you along your path to compacting your life within Minecraft.
This book will show you how to leave your silly worries of not enough room behind, because this is a whole new level.
Using this book is straight forward, just click the arrow at the bottom right.
As you can probably tell, this mod doesn't add many things.
What we lose in number of things, we gain in functionality.
info.page.1:
So, onto the only block, The Dimensional Pocket.
When placed and on right click with an empty hand, you'll enter it.

That's right.

Enter the block.
info.page.2:
To get out, it's simply a shift right click with an empty hand on the wall.

Be careful, you can get trapped inside if something breaks the Dimensional Pocket!
So, while a friend is inside a Dimensional Pocket, you can break it on him, and carry him around with you.

Portable friend. <3
info.page.3:
When you're inside a Dimensional Pocket, you'll notice a strange marked spot on each wall.
Those are called Connectors and mark the spots that actually interact with a corresponding face on the outside.

You'll figure out everything else on your own. :)
info.page.4:
One more thing:

The Dimensional Pocket needs two different crystals in it's crafting recipe. Those crystals do also have uses aside from just being a crafting ingredient.

If you want to know those uses, press [Shift] while hovering over a crystal in your inventory.
info.page.5:
End Crystal

Right click while inside a Dimensional Pocket to set your spawn point there.

Useful if you want to move in for good.
info.page.6:
Nether Crystal

Right click a face of a Dimensional Pocket to toggle that side's state.

Sneak right click the inside wall of a Pocket to move its Connector.
